```{r}
#| label: setup

library(readr)
crew <- read_csv("astronauts.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Missions

The log holds `r format(nrow(crew), big.mark = ",")` missions. Mission length is skewed: the median mission lasted `r round(median(crew$hours_mission))` hours.
